verdict.rationale: Ledgy documents a public API. It authenticates with OAuth 2.0 client_credentials service-account tokens, which you create in Company Settings and whose server metadata is discoverable. The only documented operations are auth, companyCaptable and companyTransactions, and they are read-only, with pagination and changed-since retrieval. That lets an agent read cap table data but not evidently drive the product. Probes found no machine-readable OpenAPI spec and no llms.txt. Missing for 10: documented write/action operations (e.g. creating grants or transactions), a published OpenAPI/schema, broader endpoint coverage, independent or hands-on corroboration.
